fz-ts-footnote-row.owner: server (Rust typeset rows); client side checked by ui-51
fz-ts-footnote-row.why: after typing in a footnote's text the run's own satex/typeset rows (satexTypesetOrigins) hold the footnote twice: the new text (line 3) and the old `1A short note.` (line 8), also after the run lands; the client shows what it gets. Needs the server to drop the previous run's footnote insert. Timing dependent (1 of 3 runs)

sync-usetikzlibrary.owner: server (Rust rerun from a checkpoint); evidence by ui-51
sync-usetikzlibrary.why: the client is in sync (last didChange text == editor text, findings version == sent version), but the wasm run of the final text reads `\\use`/`\\useti` (the name as an earlier run met it mid-typing) followed by `tikzlibrary…` as text: a rerun resumes inside line 3 with the old token; native `satex lint` of the final text is clean

sync-stray-brace.why: the wasm server publishes an empty diagnostics list for the text's version (raw publishDiagnostics captured: `diagnostics: []`), also with the brace there from the start (no resume), while native `satex lint` of the same text reports C013 `Too many }'s` at 8:18: the client shows what it gets

tc-type-begin-arg.owner: server (Rust: environment effects for the echo) + Type-mode echo
tc-type-begin-arg.why: the echo no longer prints the environment's name, but sets \begin{center} Quokka \end{center} on the row typed in, while TeX starts a centred row a \topsep lower: the caret jumps ~50 px as the build lands. A fix without a name table needs the run to report, per environment name, what its begin code leaves: the vertical space it adds (\topsep, \partopsep, \parskip as \@trivlist adds them, ltlists.dtx) and the paragraph shape it sets (\leftskip, \rightskip, \parfillskip: \centering's 0pt plus 1fil), e.g. in the page view's run lengths or a satex/envEffect query

forest-sibling.owner: server (wasm text sync); evidence by ui-61
forest-sibling.why: under load the snapshot printer answers `a place outside the text` (src/lsp/snapshot.rs edits_of): the wasm server holds an older, shorter text of hello.tex than the editor, though the client sent the scenario's text (didChange v2, 1359 chars) before the request. Intermittent: passed 1 of 2 runs (forest-sibling 2 of 3); evidence target/scratch/ui-61/dbg-forest.log
forest-sibling.match: ^source unchanged \(toast: a place outside the text\)

insert-hello.owner: snapshot printer package provider (src/lsp/snapshot.rs write, linter::shared::provider)
insert-hello.match: ins-figure-toolbar: (no graphicx load|build: no PDF|the widget open: null)
insert-hello.why: a new \includegraphics[width=…] in a document without graphics loads: the snapshot printer's provider picks graphics, whose \includegraphics takes no key options, so the build fails (2 errors) and the image dialog finds no figure; graphicx is the package a keyed call needs

tc-type-begin-enter.owner: server (Rust: environment effects for the echo) + Type-mode echo
tc-type-begin-enter.why: the same root as tc-type-begin-arg: the echo sets the environment's body on the row typed in, TeX a centred row a \topsep lower

tc-type-align-loads.why: the exports index records only names defined as a control sequence (`\def\align`, amstex.sty), never an environment defined by a braced name (`\newenvironment{align}`, amsmath.sty): align is offered with `\usepackage{amstex}`, which is obsolete and errors; then the echo's environment row (tc-type-begin-arg); the echo of a display's body (x typed into align or equation, no load needed) stays after the build has it, so the page never settles

tc-type-load-keeps-caret.why: x lands (the check this scenario guards); the build fails on the \usepackage{amstex} the exports index offers for align (tc-type-align-loads) and the echo's environment row jumps (tc-type-begin-arg); the echo of a display's body (x typed into align or equation, no load needed) stays after the build has it, so the page never settles

table-nested-edit.owner: main session: wasm rebuild with widgets land-03 (src/lsp/tabular.rs nested env)
table-nested-edit.match: ^(Apply after a cell edit wrote nothing|after the edit:)
table-nested-edit.why: the playground's wasm parses a tabular nested in a cell as two outer rows (fixed natively in land-03, lsp::tabular::tests::a_nested_tabular_is_one_cell); the dialog then shows a bogus row 3, Enter after an edit pads it, and Apply writes nothing

enter-in-list.why: Enter on an item's line writes the next \item (source right), but the echo sets the typed item's words on the row typed in, not as a new item a row lower with its label: the caret jumps when the build lands

listing.why: a listing typed into from the PDF: the echo measures its row in the text font, the landed build's glyphs sit up to 6 px left, so the caret jumps on landing (the click and the typing work since 2026-11-21: verbatim characters are no macro output)

u-par-in-math-covered.why: a blank line inside equation/align*: satex reports it (C008, C013) one line off pdfTeX's l. line, so the squiggle is not where TeX stops

u-table-add-col-while-editing.why: table widget: + (column at the end) while a cell is being edited throws NotFoundError replaceChildren (blur handler); the column is not added

u-tikz-drag-node-text.why: Type mode on (default): a drag that starts on a node's text does nothing, no move, no ghost, no selection

u-edit-latency-slides.match: findings of the edit came after
u-edit-latency-slides.why: slides.tex: one typed letter reruns the whole document (run 2, ~4 s) instead of resuming: the findings come after 4 s, want 2 s. (The stale-forever list, a run installed but never published after a widget question moved the cancel counter, is fixed by caretcomp 2026-11-21: publish_installed.)

demo-sum.owner: preview (caret at a formula's end, typecaret open item)
demo-sum.why: the echo draws $\sum_i x_42$ right (∑ in the math fallback, x italic, 42 lowered: the check this scenario guards), but once the build lands the caret after the closing $ goes to the formula's start (76 px back): the formula's source tokens pair with its first page word, so the caret's word is ∑, not x42 (pdfTypeDraw, B === g.text)

math-sum.owner: preview (caret at a formula's end, typecaret open item)
math-sum.why: the landed build moves the caret about 6 px at a sum typed in math (`landed: ok moved by -5.8 px`); fails without the day's edits too, same root as demo-sum-typed

demo-sum-typed.owner: preview (caret at a formula's end, typecaret open item)
demo-sum-typed.why: the stacked previews (a second ∑, a bar of one) are fixed and guarded here (echo rows overlap); open: a build of the formula typed so far (`\(\su`, error-recovered) lands and the caret goes where that page ends it (after `by`, 30 px back), and the row's echo mixes the page face with the fallback
